name: grid_sod
title: Synthetic profile grid in the survey's vocabulary, incomes cut at 25 and 40 thousand
note: 360 synthetic profiles = 2 x 3 x 5 x 3 x 4, the full factorial of the levels below, numbered from 1 with the first column varying slowest (`panel.grid`); the source is this declaration. Gender, education and interest are the survey's answers, age_range its five bands. The incomes are written in the survey's style but are not its bands: three bands that cover every income, cut at 25 and 40 thousand. The sod grid since 2026-11-15 (DECISIONS.md section 28), replacing grid_sod_retired (incomes with gaps) and grid_sod45_retired (cut at 25 and 45 thousand); no run has been sent it yet.
